# Coralum

> Coralum is specialist-designed telehealth for Parkinson's disease. It helps people with Parkinson's and their caregivers stay supported between neurology visits through symptom tracking and proactive care.

Coralum is a digital health company focused on closing the "care loop" for Parkinson's disease — the long gaps between neurology appointments where symptoms change and problems go unnoticed. The platform helps patients and caregivers track symptoms, understand day-to-day changes, and get proactive support, so care teams have better information and patients have fewer surprises.

Coralum was developed by clinicians, in collaboration with the Stanford Mussallem Center for Biodesign, and is backed by 2048 Ventures. The product is currently in pre-launch with an open waitlist.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://coralum.ai): What Coralum is and how it helps people with Parkinson's between visits.
- [Join the waitlist](https://coralum.ai/waitlist): Sign up for early access to Coralum.

## Topics Coralum covers
- Parkinson's disease care and telehealth
- Symptom tracking and monitoring between neurology visits
- Motor fluctuations and medication "wearing off" / "off" episodes
- Caregiver support for Parkinson's
- Remote patient monitoring for neurodegenerative conditions
